intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Pim arrives at a run, waving a list. The handwriting gets bigger toward the bottom.

intro.speaker: PIM
intro.text: “Miss Senna, I want to learn medicine! Which plants are poison? Can I hold the foxglove? Are there needles?”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “All of them, in the right amount. No. And there are no needles, Pim. There have never been needles.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She takes the list and folds it very small, as if it might go off.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “He touches everything. Last week he licked a doorknob to find out what brass tastes like.”

options.labelText: “Maybe he’s a bit young for this? The stables might be safer for now.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Pim goes back anyway. Senna watches him the whole way, as if he might trip over the air.

options.labelText: “Start him somewhere safe. Who’s in charge of counting the boiled sweets?”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “The sweets. Nothing in that bag can hurt him except the arithmetic.”

branch.speaker: PIM
branch.text: “Forty-one! Is that right? Is it a test? Did I pass?”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “It’s forty. You’ve got one in your cheek. Write *forty*.”

options.labelText: “Why bother? He’s just a stable boy.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “He can name six plants you shouldn’t eat. You’ve tried to eat two of them.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes Pim by the sleeve and walks off, already explaining the first one.
